illustration: An empty inbox tray waiting for its first notification

inbox.title: Messages
inbox.description: Everything that happened on your reviews — mentions, replies, decisions and new versions.

nothingRead.title: Nothing read yet
nothingRead.body: Everything in your inbox is still waiting for you.

loadError.title: Your messages didn't make it to the desk
loadError.message: The inbox could not be loaded. It is almost certainly the connection, not your notifications — they are safe.

empty.title: Your inbox is listening
empty.body: Nothing has landed yet. The moment someone names you in a comment, answers one of your annotations or moves a review along, it shows up here — no mailbox required.
empty.hint: Activity on a review is what fills this inbox.

caughtUp.title: Inbox zero
caughtUp.body: You have read everything. New activity on your reviews will show up the moment it happens.

notFound.title: This message has already been filed away
notFound.message: No notification answers to that link. It may have been about a review that has since been removed.

title.participantAdded: You were added to a review
title.tombstone: A review you no longer have access to

body.mention: {{actor}} mentioned you in a comment on “{{review}}”.
body.participantAdded: {{actor}} added you as a reviewer on “{{review}}”.
body.reviewDeleted: “{{review}}” was permanently deleted by an administrator.
body.tombstone: This notification refers to a review that is no longer available to you.
